raw_graphql_pull_request.body: # Description This PR switches the Qwen3-30B-A3B FP8 MI355X example config to Primus-Turbo tensorwise FP8 and turns on the Turbo fusions. On `rocm/primus:v26.7`, 8× MI355X go from **28,581 to 41,633 tokens/s/GPU (+45.7%)**. The loss curve tracks the stock run, about 0.01 lower throughout (tensorwise current scaling here, delayed scaling in the stock config). New in this PR: * Fused QKV split + Q/K RMSNorm + RoPE for head_dim 128. The patch was GPT-OSS-only (head_dim 64) before. * `turbo_fp8_permute`: the DeepEP permute hands the fused grouped MLP FP8 tokens, and takes its gradient back in FP8. * A fix for `enable_turbo_attention_float8`, which failed on its first call. **Requires Primus-Turbo main** (AMD-AGI/Primus-Turbo#555 and #556; verified at `67b8e093`). The Turbo in `rocm/primus:v26.7` and the `TURBO_COMMIT` in `tools/installation/setup.sh` predate both; with them, set `turbo_fp8_permute: false`. ## Results `rocm/primus:v26.7`, 8× MI355X, EP8, MBS 8, GBS 512, seq 4096, mock data, 50 steps; performance is the mean of iterations 11–50. | run | ms/iter | TFLOP/s/GPU | tokens/s/GPU | loss@50 | | -------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ------------ | ----------- | | v26.7 image (Primus + Turbo as shipped) | 9172.0 | 650.3 | 28,581 | 10.79581 | | this PR + Primus-Turbo main | 6296.6 | 947.2 | 41,633 | 10.78232 | Known issue: during development, 1 of 13 runs at `turbo_deepep_num_cu: 160` hit a NaN loss on one rank in the first few iterations; it did not reproduce in verification. ## Changes * `examples/megatron/configs/MI355X/qwen3_30B_A3B-FP8-pretrain.yaml`: tensorwise FP8 on Turbo GEMM / grouped GEMM, `use_turbo_fused_qk_rmsnorm_rope`, `turbo_fused_grouped_gemm`, `use_turbo_fused_act_with_probs`, `turbo_fp8_permute` and `turbo_deepep_num_cu: 160`. * `qk_rmsnorm_rope_patches.py`: accept the head_dims Turbo supports (64, 128) and TE RMSNorm. The patch is now switched on by `use_turbo_fused_qk_rmsnorm_rope` (new in `primus_turbo.yaml`, default false) instead of the `PRIMUS_FUSED_QK_RMSNORM_ROPE` environment variable, which no longer has any effect. * `primus_turbo.py`: FP8 dispatch / combine in `PrimusTurboDeepEPTokenDispatcher` behind `turbo_fp8_permute`; FP8 attention fix. * `primus_turbo.yaml`, `rocm_arg_validation.py`: the new `turbo_fp8_permute` flag (default false) and its validation. ## Tests * New unit tests for `turbo_fp8_permute` validation and dtype selection, and for the `use_turbo_fused_qk_rmsnorm_rope` switch; the related Megatron unit tests pass ({UNIT_RESULT}). * End-to-end runs above.

### 🟡 Changes recommended The default recipe depends on unavailable Turbo APIs, permits an incompatible configuration, and enables a setting with known NaN failures.
3 open findings - [Guard rope import against unsupported Turbo versions](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1247#discussion_r4238208510) · New - [Reject incompatible sink attention with FP8 attention](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1247#discussion_r4238208533) · New - [Require grouped GEMM for Turbo FP8 permute](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1247#discussion_r4238208558) · New
What changed in this PR Optimizes Qwen3-30B-A3B FP8 training using Primus-Turbo tensorwise FP8 and fused kernels. **Changes:** - Adds FP8 DeepEP permute support and validation. - Expands fused Q/K RMSNorm + RoPE support to head dimension 128. - Enables and tunes Turbo optimizations in the MI355X recipe. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `examples/​megatron/​configs/​MI355X/​qwen3_30B_A3B-FP8-pretrain.yaml` | Enables optimized Turbo FP8 recipe. | | `primus/​backends/​megatron/​core/​extensions/​primus_turbo.py` | Integrates FP8 attention and permute behavior. | | `primus/​backends/​megatron/​patches/​args/​rocm_arg_validation.py` | Validates FP8 permute configuration. | | `primus/​backends/​megatron/​patches/​turbo/​qk_rmsnorm_rope_patches.py` | Supports additional fused-attention shapes and norms. | | `primus/​configs/​modules/​megatron/​primus_turbo.yaml` | Defines the new opt-in flag. | | `tests/​unit_tests/​backends/​megatron/​test_rocm_arg_validation.py` | Tests argument validation. | | `tests/​unit_tests/​backends/​megatron/​test_turbo_fp8_permute_dtypes.py` | Tests FP8 dtype selection. |
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced --- 💡 Add a `code-review` agent skill or configure MCP servers for context-aware, tailored reviews. Learn more in the docs.

Enabling this environment variable is not compatible with the standard MI355X install: `tools/installation/setup.sh:121` pins Turbo `9c645c5...`, whose `primus_turbo.pytorch.ops` package has no `rope` module. The patch imports that module before the `QK_RMSNORM_ROPE_HEAD_DIMS` fallback, so startup raises `ModuleNotFoundError` rather than keeping the unfused path promised by the comment. Update the pinned dependency (after the required Turbo changes merge) or capability-gate the whole patch.

This issue also appears in the following locations of the same file:
- line 96
- line 104

This still passes `sink` whenever sink attention is enabled, but the selected FP8 function has no `sink` parameter. Since `use_sink_attention` and `enable_turbo_attention_float8` are independent public flags and validation does not reject the combination, that configuration still fails on its first call. Reject the combination clearly or select a sink-capable non-FP8 implementation.

nodes.body: `turbo_fp8_permute` also requires `use_turbo_grouped_gemm=True`. Without it, the spec provider builds `TEGroupedMLP`, but the dispatcher still emits a Turbo `QuantizedTensor` under tensorwise FP8, so the advertised validation accepts a configuration with no compatible consumer. Add this flag to the required set and cover it in the parameterized rejection test.

+def validate_turbo_fp8_permute(args) -> None:
+    """The FP8 permute handoff only has one consumer: the fused grouped MLP behind Turbo DeepEP."""
+    option = "turbo_fp8_permute"
+    if not getattr(args, option, False):
+        return
+    for required in ("enable_primus_turbo", "use_turbo_deepep", "turbo_fused_grouped_gemm"):

### 🟡 Changes recommended The shipped Turbo pin lacks the enabled permutation API, and FP8 attention still fails when combined with sink attention.
5 open findings - [Update Turbo pins before enabling quantize_dtype](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1247#discussion_r4240875670) · New - [Reject incompatible sink attention with FP8 attention](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1247#discussion_r4238208533) - [Guard rope import against unsupported Turbo versions](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1247#discussion_r4238208510) - [Require grouped GEMM for Turbo FP8 permute](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1247#discussion_r4238208558) - [Update guide for changed fence setting](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1247#discussion_r4240875687) · New
Previously missed (1) In code that hasn't changed since last review
Test fused RoPE patching for head_dim 128 and TE RMSNorm `primus/​backends/​megatron/​patches/​turbo/​qk_rmsnorm_rope_patches.py:139` The existing `test_qk_rmsnorm_rope_patches.py` only tests DDP hook helpers; it does not exercise the newly broadened eligibility for head dimension 128 or plain TE `RMSNorm`. A regression that always falls back to the unfused path would therefore pass. Add a patch-level test with supported head_dim 128 and TE RMSNorm instances that verifies the fused operator is selected.
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced

This enables an API that the repository's shipped Turbo versions do not provide. The v26.8 image/bare-metal pin is `9c645c5...` (September 16), and CI uses `e2d9f1d...` (October 8), while `quantize_dtype` was introduced by Primus-Turbo #555 in `cf630aad...` on October 11. As a result, running this example with the documented release environment reaches `_post_dispatch(..., quantize_dtype=...)` and fails on its first dispatch. Please update the production and CI Turbo pins to a commit containing #555 (and its required stack), or keep this option disabled in the shipped config until that dependency is available.

+
+"""
+Unit tests for the FP8 dtypes the Turbo DeepEP dispatcher asks the permute for under
+``turbo_fp8_permute``. Quantizing before permute is only exact for tensorwise current
+scaling, so every other state must keep the bf16 permute.
+"""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+from tests.utils import skip_if_no_cuda
+
+skip_if_no_cuda()
+
+from primus_turbo.pytorch.core.low_precision import (  # noqa: E402  isort:skip
+    Format,
+    ScalingGranularity,
+    float8_e4m3,
+    float8_e5m2,
+)
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.extensions.primus_turbo import (  # noqa: E402  isort:skip
+    PrimusTurboDeepEPTokenDispatcher,
+    PrimusTurboLowPrecisionGlobalStateManager,
+    PrimusTurboQuantConfig,
+)
+
+
+def _dtypes(monkeypatch, *, flag=True, turbo_fp8=True, quant_config=None):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(PrimusTurboLowPrecisionGlobalStateManager, "PRIMUS_TURBO_FP8_ENABLED", turbo_fp8)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(PrimusTurboLowPrecisionGlobalStateManager, "PRIMUS_TURBO_QUANT_CONFIG", quant_config)
+    dispatcher = SimpleNamespace(turbo_fp8_permute=flag)
+    return PrimusTurboDeepEPTokenDispatcher._fp8_permute_dtypes(dispatcher)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("fmt", "expected"),
+    [
+        (Format.HYBRID, (float8_e4m3, float8_e5m2)),
+        (Format.E4M3, (float8_e4m3, float8_e4m3)),
+    ],
+)
+def test_tensorwise_returns_input_and_grad_dtypes(monkeypatch, fmt, expected):
+    quant_config = PrimusTurboQuantConfig(format=fmt, granularity=ScalingGranularity.TENSORWISE)
+    assert _dtypes(monkeypatch, quant_config=quant_config) == expected
+
+
+def test_flag_off_keeps_bf16_permute(monkeypatch):
+    quant_config = PrimusTurboQuantConfig(format=Format.HYBRID, granularity=ScalingGranularity.TENSORWISE)
+    assert _dtypes(monkeypatch, flag=False, quant_config=quant_config) == (None, None)
+
+
+def test_turbo_fp8_off_keeps_bf16_permute(monkeypatch):
+    """A layer outside Turbo FP8 (e.g. pinned to BF16) must not get FP8 tokens."""
+    quant_config = PrimusTurboQuantConfig(format=Format.HYBRID, granularity=ScalingGranularity.TENSORWISE)
+    assert _dtypes(monkeypatch, turbo_fp8=False, quant_config=quant_config) == (None, None)
+
+
+def test_blockwise_keeps_bf16_permute(monkeypatch):
+    quant_config = PrimusTurboQuantConfig(
+        format=Format.HYBRID, granularity=ScalingGranularity.BLOCKWISE, block_size=128
+    )
+    assert _dtypes(monkeypatch, quant_config=quant_config) == (None, None)

Enabling this environment variable is not compatible with the standard MI355X install: `tools/installation/setup.sh:121` pins Turbo `9c645c5...`, whose `primus_turbo.pytorch.ops` package has no `rope` module. The patch imports that module before the `QK_RMSNORM_ROPE_HEAD_DIMS` fallback, so startup raises `ModuleNotFoundError` rather than keeping the unfused path promised by the comment. Update the pinned dependency (after the required Turbo changes merge) or capability-gate the whole patch.

This issue also appears in the following locations of the same file:
- line 96
- line 104

This still passes `sink` whenever sink attention is enabled, but the selected FP8 function has no `sink` parameter. Since `use_sink_attention` and `enable_turbo_attention_float8` are independent public flags and validation does not reject the combination, that configuration still fails on its first call. Reject the combination clearly or select a sink-capable non-FP8 implementation.

inline_comments.body: This enables an API that the repository's shipped Turbo versions do not provide. The v26.8 image/bare-metal pin is `9c645c5...` (September 16), and CI uses `e2d9f1d...` (October 8), while `quantize_dtype` was introduced by Primus-Turbo #555 in `cf630aad...` on October 11. As a result, running this example with the documented release environment reaches `_post_dispatch(..., quantize_dtype=...)` and fails on its first dispatch. Please update the production and CI Turbo pins to a commit containing #555 (and its required stack), or keep this option disabled in the shipped config until that dependency is available.
